content: Johannes Baptista We Re Llimeseloh
Irel yodla ngo Yerodes Antipas we tamol wol Galilee sa rongrong kofal Jesus.
Yesa kangalur tamol kowe wocchilal bo, “Yeramtala ila Johannes Baptista le sa molow tefael mo irel maes. Ila fal le yor kkelal le be ffaor kkemal.”
Yerodes molwe ye sor le rebe ddorfi Johannes resa hohoyu, resa yetolong lal kalbus. Ye foru mele le fael Herodias we ril Philip we bisil.
Bo ye mel sew yad le Johannes Baptista ye kangalu Yerodes bo, “Ye tafel le hobe rili Herodias!”
Iwe Yerodes sa luluwaley le be llimeseloh, ngo ye metagur Jews kowe bo re yitili Johannes le iy semal profeta.
Yodwe yela hola rallawe bungul yal subdoh Yerodes, ngo lefechig we lol Herodias yesa barog mo imor chol tteydoh we. Yesa momay depel Yerodes ngali,
ngo yesa kangalu bo, “Isa hatugulu ngalug le te tugul mele hobe dongor ngo ibe fang ngalug!”
Molwe sil sa kangalu lefechig we mele yebe dongor. Iwe ngo iy, sala sor bo, “Fang ngalyey chog igla molwe chemel Johannes Baptista le be mel lal sew plate!”
Sa tayikof depel king we, ngo ligdi bo fael pedal hapatpat we yesa hatugulu mo imor panger rechokwe ye fesangurdoh, mele yesa sor bo rebe ngaley lefechig we molwe ye dodongor.
Iwe yesa sor bo re bela supiyloh molwe uyel Johannes mo lal kalbus.
Re sala hasidoh molwe chemel Johannes le ye mel lal sew plate, resa ngaley lefechig we, ngo iy yesa hasiloh irel molwe sil.
Mokwe re dabeyel Johannes resa budoh hasi molwe porgol re sala leba. Ngo resa loh re sala kangalu Jesus.
Jesus Ye Hamongoyur Limngeras Mal

Yodwe Jesus yela rongrong molwe kofal Johannes, ngo sa dage seyey boat sa loh solbos le tor loh yarmat iyang sala iy loh chog. Yarmat rela rongrong molwe yesa loh ngo resa ligdi mokwe haplomor resa dar wol fuluy resa meraloh.
Jesus sa dediy mo yuchul boat we ngo yodwe yela wiri leper buwa we ngo sa ddidoh yal fahor, iwe yesa hachuya yar tomay rechokwe re tomay mo luwulur.
Yela llefhafdoh, ngo mokwe re dabeyel Jesus resa budoh irel resa kangalu bo, “Hole hamderar yarmat bo re bele loh, bo re bela chuway fedal haler luwul haplom kalay.”
Iwe Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Heramo rete loh, hala fang haler hami!”
Iwe ngo resa hatefali ngo resa sor bo, “Hal limay flowa mo rumal yig mele ye mel.”
Jesus sa sor bo, “Ha hasidoh irey.”

Yesa kangalur yarmat bo rebe marodiy wol fadil kowe; iwe yesa hasi flowa we limay mo yig we rumal, sa kaladah woal laeng, ngo sa kangalu Deus yal hachigchig. Yesa dipi flowa kowe sa ngaler mokwe re dabeyal, ngo mokwe re dabeyal resa yildi ngalir yarmat.
Pangal yarmat ngo re mongoy, ngo re madloh iyang. Iwe ngo mokwe re dabeyel Jesus resa hateyili fengali mokwe lutgul, ngo ye ssog seg mo ruwow bachebach iyang.
Leper mal le re mongoy, ila rebe lemngeras le rete papa fefel mo yalwich.
Jesus Ye Darloh Wol Chael
Jesus ye kangalur mokwe re dabeyal bo rebe dage boat we resa hamoloh rel laom we sere, irel yodwe ye chil kekalahor yarmat.
Wol miril yal halhor yarmat, ngo sa bidah wol sew tagitat bo bela mapel. Yela llefhafdoh, ngo sa Jesus loh chog lobowe.
Yela yodla ngo sa ddaw loh boat we. Sa kkel doh yaeng, ngo law sa kekalluya fedaley boat we.
Llepdal suluw ngal wolow kolok lemerral, ngo Jesus sa budoh irel mokwe re dabeyal le ye dedardoh wol taed.
Yodla rela wiri le ye dedarloh wol chal, ngo sa kkel yar rusmes. Resa tawulagili luwol yar rusmes le re sor bo, “Semal yalus!”
Yodla chog ngo Jesus sa maliliy ngalir le ye sor bo, “Ha haakkela lal dipmi, Ngang mele, ha towe motog!”
Iwe Pedrus sa maliliy ngo sa sor bo, “Samol, hare tos le gel mala ngo hosa ffesanguyey bo ibe darwol taed isa buyoy irem.”
Jesus sa sor bo, “Budoh!” Iwe Pedrus sa dediy mo yuchul boat we sa darloh irel Jesus le ye dar wol taed.
Ngo yodwe Pedrus yela lulwaleloh kkelel yang we, ngo sa budoh yal motog, ngo sa chaep yal duddubloh luwul taed. Yesa tawul loh le ye sor bo, “Samol, hadorayey!”
Jesus sa cchangloh sala ddorfi ngo sa kangalu bo, “Ye hal sugfed yam tugul! Meda mele hola ye yeyewal iyang?”
Resa chudah yuchul boat we ngo yela malululoh.
Iwe ngo mokwe re dabeyal we re mel yuchul boat we resa hasrowu Jesus. Ngo resa sor bo, “Tos bo gel molowe Lol Deus!”
Jesus Ye Hachuya Yar Yarmat Tomay Mo Wol Gennesaret
Resa supiloh laom we re sala budoh wol Gennesaret
ngo yarmatal lobowe re gula Jesus. Iwe resa hagloyurloh yarmat wol pangal lobo kawe bo re bela hasidoh rechoka re tomay irel Jesus.
Resa hafalpechey hare be mechal bo rechokla re tomay rebe yangsi ngachel mala mengagol; panger rechokla re yangsi molwe mengagol, ngo ye chuy yar tomay.
